primary_anchor_zh: 彼此分开的四幅大型方形画布
story_reason_zh: 画布被取到隔壁上底色，随后放回画室墙边

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 一组大型画布在明亮画室的长墙前，画布表面接收均匀天光。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 画布表面接收均匀天光
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 彼此分开的四幅大型方形画布占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 画家缓慢推动装有四幅画布的画架离开画室；随后呈现空长墙和浅色地板。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 画家缓慢推动装有四幅画布的画架离开画室
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 画家缓慢将装有四幅分开画布的画架推回长墙前
shot_design.main_action_zh: 画家缓慢将装有四幅分开画布的画架推回长墙前
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 清楚呈现彼此分开的四幅大型方形画布；不要求复现精确排列。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed wide shot frames four large square canvases, clearly separated along the wall in a bright painting studio. Even skylight rests across their broad surfaces.

A fixed wide shot shows four large square canvases, clearly separated along the wall in a bright painting studio. A painter slowly rolls a rack holding all four square canvases through the studio doorway and out of frame. The fixed camera then holds on the empty long wall and the pale studio floor. A thin curtain beneath the skylight moves gently.

A fixed wide shot holds on the empty long wall and the pale studio floor. A painter slowly rolls a rack holding four large separated square canvases back into frame and stops it along the studio wall.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 画家缓慢推动装有四幅画布的画架离开画室
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 画家缓慢将装有四幅分开画布的画架推回长墙前
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
